rules.accepted_credit_types: Any CE contributing to dental knowledge or patient services; the Commission does not approve specific courses. Live courses, live interactive webinars, study clubs, postdoctoral education; self-study online/mail counts half (30 min per hour); limits on practice management (21 h), teaching, supervision, journal reading, volunteer care.
rules.alternatives: Current certification/recertification from an ADA/ABDS-recognized specialty board, or AGD Fellowship/Mastership or Lifelong Learning and Service Recognition award in the period counts as 62 hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: For dentists first licensed in 2019 or later the 3-year reporting period starts on the date of licensure.
rules.audit_note: Attestation at renewal every three years; Commission may randomly audit up to 25% of dentists after renewal. Keep certificates showing date, hours and course title.

topics.who: Commission-approved dental jurisprudence examination every 3 years (1 hour credit)
One-time training from the DOH model list, in the first full reporting period after licensure
Dentists licensed to prescribe opioids: one-time best-practices course in the first full reporting period after licensure
Current healthcare-provider BLS with hands-on skills; max 3 h credit per 3 years

rules.notes: License renews every year on the birthday; CE attested every 3 years. Current healthcare-provider BLS with hands-on skills required for all direct patient care staff (max 3 h credit per 3 years).
